items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: I would do anything for you, Liza

ctx.x: Do you remember much about the record date you did for Brunswick in early 1940? You did played I Got Rhythm & Cocktails for two, I Ain't Got Nobody, After you've gone
Moonglow... I would do anything for you, Liza, Tea for Two, Honey, suckle Rose.
We did all that many? I didn't know we did that many. Some of 'em was for, what do you call that -- What's the one that started with a "D", Decca...
